# Contract: dx-audit

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: engineering. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
A fresh-user documentation journey with timed friction evidence, graded errors and ready-to-paste rewrites.

## Use it for
- "DX audit of this SDK"
- "try this like a new user"

## Not for
- API shape review (api-design-review)

## Accepted inputs
A tool, one goal, a success definition, a docs entry point.

## Deliverables
audit.md, friction.json, timeline, screenshots, outputs.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+

Optional:
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Opens the tool's public docs; never signs up or enters credentials.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None (stops at auth walls).

## Workflow
1. Set up (ask the user, one question at a time)
2. A clean environment
3. Follow the docs literally
4. Walls: stop and ask
5. Break it on purpose: three error checks
6. Write the teardown

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Whether to continue past an auth wall with the user's own key

## Quality checks
- metrics from the log
- no personal paths in outputs

## Common failures
- Sandbox leaks the auditor's own setup

## Limitations
- The env -i sandbox example is POSIX; on Windows use a fresh user profile or container

## Reproducible example
A local documentation fixture (evidence/dx-audit). Upstream's uv example screenshots are not shipped.
